title: Human-in-the-loop agent
subtitle: A runnable Human-in-the-Loop Agent
description: An agent reviews a vendor invoice against its purchase order, converts currency via a real API when needed, and decides whether to release payment or dispute it. Releasing payment is itself a tool the agent calls that is a human user task - the agent never leaves its reasoning loop to get that approval. A second, independent compliance sign-off task sits after the agent finishes, showing the difference between an in-loop, agent-native approval gate and a classic bolted-on-style checkpoint.
creator: Camunda
thumbnailAlt: BPMN model: an Invoice Review Agent ad-hoc subprocess containing a Request payment release human task as one of the agent's own tools, gating a Release payment call, followed by a separate Final compliance sign-off human task outside the subprocess.
